summary.title: In short
summary.body: {site} is the personal blog of {owner}. It records only the little information needed to understand readership and prevent abuse. No selling data, no ads, no cross-site tracking.

browse.title: What is recorded while you browse

items.page: The pages you visit, when, and which page you came from.
items.network: Your IP address, plus the approximate region and ISP looked up from it. Only the site owner can see IP addresses in the admin console; they are never made public.
items.browser: Basic information your browser exposes: OS, browser, device type, screen size, language, time zone, light / dark preference, and whether it is controlled by an automation program.
items.engagement: Reading activity: engaged time on the page, how far you scrolled, which outbound links or downloads you clicked, and performance data such as page load speed.

browse.note: We check the IP location against your time zone and language to tell whether a visit went through a proxy or came from a bot, and use the result only for statistics. We do not collect device fingerprints such as canvas, graphics card, or audio, nor font lists or precise location. Visits from search engine crawlers and from the site owner are not recorded.

items.profile: Account: username, nickname, and email; passwords are stored encrypted. When you sign in with a third-party account, we receive the name, email, and avatar it provides. Each sign-in records the IP address used, to keep your account secure. Your profile page shows the approximate region of your latest sign-in by default; you can turn this off in account settings.
items.comment: Comments and likes: the content, plus the IP and approximate region at the time of posting. IPs are never made public; you decide whether the region and client info are shown.

items.visitor: nb_vid: a random visitor ID used to tell new and returning visitors apart, kept for 1 year.
items.login: token, refresh_token: sign-in state; oidc_nonce: third-party sign-in verification, expires after 10 minutes.
items.local: Preferences such as theme and volume are stored only in your browser. This site uses no advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

items.visit: Visit and interaction records: deleted automatically after {days} days.
items.visitor: Visitor summary (latest region, device, and visit count): deleted 1 year after the last visit.
items.account: Accounts and comments: until you delete them or close your account.

third_party.title: Third-party services
third_party.body: CAPTCHA, third-party sign-in, Gravatar avatars, CDN resources, and embedded content let the respective services see your IP, which they handle under their own privacy policies. The weather card uses your location, rounded to about 1 km, only after you allow it, and discards it right after use. IPv4 locations are looked up offline on this site’s server; IPv6 locations may be looked up through a third party. Beyond that, we don’t share your information with anyone.

choices.title: What you can do

items.dnt: If you don’t want to be recorded: turn on “Do Not Track” or “Global Privacy Control” in your browser. The site then only counts the visit anonymously: it doesn’t store your IP, read the browser information above, record reading activity, or set the visitor cookie.
items.cookie: After you clear this site’s cookies, your next visit will be treated as a new visitor.
items.request: Contact the site owner {owner} to view, export, or delete records about you, or to close your account.

choices.note: If you are under 14, please get a guardian’s consent before registering or commenting. When this policy changes, the date on this page will be updated, and major changes will be announced on the site. Contact details are in the footer or on the site owner’s homepage.

visits.inferred_hint: IP location conflicts with time zone and language; region inferred from other signals
visits.ip_untrusted_hint: IP location conflicts with other signals or belongs to a data center range; not trusted

trusted.label: Trusted
trusted.why: All signals agree with each other; the IP location is reliable.

proxy.label: Likely proxy
proxy.why: The IP location conflicts with signals such as time zone and language, or belongs to a data center range. The visit most likely went through a proxy / VPN. Use the inferred region instead.

spoofed.label: Spoofed environment
spoofed.why: What the browser reports about itself is contradictory (UA, Client Hints, UTC offset, touch, etc.). A UA switcher extension, anti-detect browser, or tampering script may be in use.

bot.label: Likely automated
bot.why: Shows signs of automation, most likely a crawler or script. Not counted in page views or visitors.

unknown.label: Insufficient signals
unknown.why: The visitor enabled “Do Not Track” or did not report browser signals. Only a basic record was kept, so no verdict is possible.

tz_vs_ip.name: Time zone doesn’t match IP location
tz_vs_ip.why: VPNs and proxies change only the exit IP, not the system time zone, so the time zone is closer to the real location.

lang_vs_ip.name: Language doesn’t match IP location
lang_vs_ip.why: Language reflects usage habits. A mismatch on its own usually means a user abroad; a mismatch together with the time zone means the IP is not the real location.

datacenter_ip.name: IP belongs to a data center / cloud provider
datacenter_ip.why: Home broadband and mobile networks rarely use data center IPs directly, while most VPNs, proxies, and crawlers run on cloud servers.

ip_jump.name: IP country changed for the same visitor
ip_jump.why: The time zone stayed the same and only the IP country changed, which usually means the proxy node was switched.

tz_hidden.name: Time zone hidden as UTC
tz_hidden.why: Tor Browser, Firefox’s fingerprinting resistance mode, and similar tools always report UTC; the time zone is then left out of region inference.

offset_vs_tz.name: UTC offset doesn’t match time zone
offset_vs_tz.why: Both come from the same browser setting and should always agree. A mismatch means a script or anti-detect browser changed only one of them.

ua_vs_ch_platform.name: UA OS doesn’t match Client Hints
ua_vs_ch_platform.why: UA switcher extensions usually change only the UA string; Chromium still reports the real OS in Client Hints.

ua_vs_ch_mobile.name: UA device type doesn’t match Client Hints
ua_vs_ch_mobile.why: When the UA is changed to a phone or computer, Client Hints still report the real device type.

ua_engine_vs_ch.name: UA browser doesn’t match engine
ua_engine_vs_ch.why: Only Chromium-based browsers send Client Hints, so their presence or absence verifies the browser name in the UA.

mobile_no_touch.name: Claims to be mobile but has no touch
mobile_no_touch.why: Phones and tablets all have touchscreens; no touch points means it is actually a desktop device.

mobile_large_screen.name: Claims to be a phone but has a desktop-size screen
mobile_large_screen.why: The short side of a phone screen is usually between 320–480 CSS pixels.

accept_lang_vs_nav.name: Request header language doesn’t match browser language
accept_lang_vs_nav.why: Both come from the same browser setting. A mismatch usually means a proxy, extension, or script rewrote one of them.

ipad_desktop_ua.name: macOS UA with multi-touch (iPad)
ipad_desktop_ua.why: Safari on iPadOS requests desktop websites by default, with the same UA as a Mac. Counted as a tablet, not as spoofing.

webdriver.name: Browser under automated control
webdriver.why: navigator.webdriver is true, meaning the browser is controlled by tools such as Selenium, Puppeteer, or Playwright.

no_languages.name: Empty language list
no_languages.why: A normal browser has at least one language; an empty list is common in headless browsers.

zero_screen.name: Screen size is 0
zero_screen.why: Headless browsers often report a 0×0 screen.

reasons.offset_conflict: The time zone itself conflicts with the clock offset; left to the “UTC offset” rule
reasons.tz_ip_match: Time zone and IP are both in {country}
reasons.tz_ip_mismatch: Time zone is {tz} ({tzCountry}, {offset}), but the IP is in {ipCountry} ({ipOffsets}). The two places have different UTC offsets, so the IP is most likely a proxy exit.
reasons.tz_ip_mismatch_same_offset: Time zone is {tz} ({tzCountry}, {offset}), but the IP is in {ipCountry}. The two places share the same UTC offset, which is common with proxy nodes in nearby regions.
reasons.lang_universal: {lang} is a lingua franca and is not used for the check
reasons.lang_ip_mismatch_tz: Preferred language {lang} usually points to {countries}, but the IP is in {ipCountry}. The time zone isn’t local either, so the IP is most likely not the real location.
reasons.lang_ip_mismatch_local: Preferred language {lang} usually points to {countries}, but the IP is in {ipCountry}. The time zone matches the IP, so this looks more like a foreign-language user who is actually there.
reasons.no_isp: The location data gives no ISP
reasons.isp_datacenter: ISP is “{isp}”, a data center range.
reasons.no_history: No previous record for this visitor
reasons.ip_same: Same as last time, both in {country}
reasons.ip_jump: Last time the IP was in {from}, this time in {to}, yet the time zone is still {tz}.
reasons.ip_back: IP moved from {from} back to {to}, consistent with the time zone
reasons.tz_utc: Time zone reported as {tz}; fingerprinting protection may be on.
reasons.offset_mismatch: {tz} should currently be {expected}, but the browser clock is {offset}.
reasons.no_ch: No Client Hints in the request (Safari and Firefox don’t send them)
reasons.no_os: No OS detected in the UA
reasons.mobile_ok: UA and Client Hints agree on device type
reasons.mobile_mismatch_ua: UA shows a phone, but Sec-CH-UA-Mobile is ?0 (not a phone).
reasons.mobile_mismatch_ch: UA shows a non-phone, but Sec-CH-UA-Mobile is ?1 (phone).
reasons.engine_fake: UA claims {browser}, but the request carries Sec-CH-UA ({brands}), which only Chromium sends.
reasons.engine_no_ch_ok: {browser} doesn’t send Client Hints, as expected
reasons.ios_chrome: Browsers on iOS use WebKit and don’t send Client Hints
reasons.engine_missing_ch: UA claims {browser}, but the request lacks Sec-CH-UA, which Chromium sends by default.
reasons.browser_unchecked: Only visits claiming to be Chrome, Edge, Opera, Safari, or Firefox are checked
reasons.not_mobile: UA is not a mobile device
reasons.no_touch: UA device type is {device}, but there are 0 touch points and the pointer is {pointer}.
reasons.screen_large: Screen {screen} (CSS pixels) is clearly larger than a phone.
reasons.ipad: macOS UA, yet {points} touch points: this is an iPad, counted as a tablet.
reasons.webdriver_on: The browser is under automated control.

notes.offset_conflict: Time zone conflicts with clock offset, not trusted
notes.tz_unknown: Time zone not in the lookup table
notes.lang_universal: Lingua francas such as English are not used for inference
notes.lang_ambiguous: This language maps to multiple regions

global.page_background_decorations_desc: Illustrations in the empty side margins during festivals; hidden below 1536px
global.page_background_image_desc: Once set, it fills the whole blog background behind the content cards; clear it to return to a plain background
global.page_background_blur_desc: In px, 0 means no blur; only applies to the background image
global.page_background_veil_desc: 0-1: with a background image, higher keeps the text readable (0.7+ for busy images); without an image this is the opacity of the plain background
global.page_background_veil_color_desc: Any CSS color; leave empty to follow the theme background. Without a background image this color fills the page at the opacity above, acting as a plain background
global.theme_pack_preview_desc: Applies to this browser only, for debugging and preview: forces the selected seasonal theme regardless of today's date. Normally keep it on "Follow date".
global.theme_pack_preview_disabled: The theme is currently disabled (switch in the color palette popover)
global.default_covers_desc: One is picked at random when a post has no cover
global.enable_register_from_oidc_desc: Create an account automatically on first OIDC sign-in
global.max_reply_depth_desc: Replies deeper than this are no longer nested
global.revision_max_keep_desc: Maximum number of history versions kept for each post or page (10–500, including published ones); the oldest are deleted automatically, while the live version and the starting point of an open editing session are always kept
global.owner_gravatar_email_desc: Used to fetch a Gravatar avatar when no avatar is set
global.section_rss_desc: Information shown in the RSS feed; defaults are used when empty
global.section_site_desc: Site name, URL and search engine information
global.section_token_desc: An expired access token is renewed automatically with the refresh token; once the refresh token expires, users must sign in again. Changes apply to new sign-ins
global.refresh_token_remember_days_desc: In days, default 30; used when "Remember me" is checked at sign-in
global.env_override_seconds_note: Set by the environment variable {name} (in seconds), which takes precedence over this setting. Remove the variable to edit it here
global.section_captcha_desc: Captcha for sign-in and sign-up. A wrong key blocks password sign-in; you can still enter the console via third-party sign-in, or set CAPTCHA_PROVIDER=disable to turn it off temporarily

global.captcha_secret_key_desc: Used only by the backend to verify responses, never exposed
global.section_email_desc: SMTP service used to send verification codes for sign-up, password reset and so on
global.email_enable_desc: Verification codes cannot be sent while disabled
global.email_port_desc: Usually 465 for SSL and 587 for STARTTLS
global.email_address_desc: Sender address of outgoing mail, usually the same as the username
global.visit_log_retention_days_desc: Visit records older than this are deleted automatically

kv.value_hint: Values are stored as JSON; strings must be wrapped in double quotes.

global.section_personalize_desc: Resources for the sidebar and third-party script on the public site. Leave empty to hide the corresponding component.
global.music_playlist_url_desc: URL of the playlist JSON file. Leave empty to hide the floating music player.
global.enable_third_party_script_desc: Loads the CDN info script on public pages when the browser is idle; never loaded in the console.
global.section_ai_desc: Used to generate AI summaries for posts. Works with any OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Ollama). Takes effect once all three fields are filled in.
global.ai_api_base_url_desc: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API, usually ending with /v1
global.ai_api_key_desc: Stored on the server only and never exposed to visitors
global.ai_model_desc: Name of a model supported by the API
global.ai_summary_concurrency_desc: Maximum number of simultaneous model requests (1–20), shared by AI summaries and AI writing in the editor; extra requests queue in order, with AI writing served first
global.lyric_annotation_ttl_days_desc: How long AI lyric effects are cached (1–365); after expiry readers keep seeing the old effects while new ones are generated in the background
global.section_music_desc: Where the floating music player on the public site gets its playlist
global.ncm_api_base_url_desc: URL of your self-hosted NeteaseCloudMusicApi Enhanced service, used to fetch playlists, audio URLs and lyrics
global.ncm_cookie_desc: Cookie of a signed-in NetEase account (must include MUSIC_U); you can also enter just the MUSIC_U value. Stored on the server only and never exposed to visitors. VIP tracks require a VIP account
global.ncm_playlist_desc: Choose from the playlists of the account behind the cookie (including saved playlists). Visitors can only play tracks in this playlist
global.ncm_song_level_desc: Higher quality uses more bandwidth for visitors; levels beyond the account's privileges fall back automatically. Lossless and Hi-Res are FLAC
global.music_ttml_url_template_desc: Your own TTML lyrics directory, preferred over the AMLL TTML DB. '{song_id}' (or '{id}') is replaced with the NetEase song id; without a placeholder it is treated as a directory: "URL/songid.ttml". Leave empty to disable
global.env_override_note: Set by the environment variable {name}, which takes precedence over this setting. Remove the variable to edit it here
global.section_sidebar_desc: Sidebar cards on the home, archive, category and tag pages, shown from top to bottom
global.sidebar_cards_desc: Each preset card can be added once. Component cards share the blog post component blocks; without a title the component is shown on its own
global.sidebar_cards_empty: No cards yet, the sidebar will be empty
global.section_weather_desc: Data source for weather cards in posts: QWeather is used once its API Host and API Key are set, otherwise Open-Meteo
global.qweather_api_host_desc: Your dedicated API Host from the QWeather console settings
global.qweather_api_key_desc: Stored on the server only and never exposed to visitors
global.ai_writing_style_desc: Followed by the editor’s AI assistant and by external AI tools connected over MCP: tone, voice, formatting habits, preferred terms and so on. An author’s request for a specific edit takes priority. Up to 4000 characters.
global.ai_writing_style_placeholder: e.g. First person, conversational but not cutesy; put spaces between Chinese and English; prefer Go for code samples; end each post with a two- or three-sentence summary.
global.section_ai_agents_desc: Site-wide switch and limits for agent-driven AI users. The AI users themselves are managed on the AI users page.
global.ai_agents_enabled_desc: Turning this off stops scheduling immediately; the Runner receives no tasks
global.ai_agent_model_ambient_desc: Model used by ambient AI users. Leave empty to use the AI model above
global.ai_agent_model_expert_desc: Model used by expert AI users. Leave empty to use the AI model above
global.ai_agents_llm_calls_per_hour_desc: Total model calls per hour across all AI users
global.ai_agents_monthly_token_budget_desc: Tokens all AI users may use per month; 0 means unlimited
global.ai_agents_comments_per_day_desc: Total comments all AI users may post per day
global.ai_agents_likes_per_day_desc: Total likes all AI users may give per day
global.ai_agents_comments_per_post_desc: AI comment limit per post = max(base, human comments × ratio)
global.ai_agents_ai_ratio_desc: AI comment limit per post = max(base, human comments × ratio)
global.ai_agents_publish_fanout_desc: How many AI users see a newly published post
global.ai_agents_quiet_hours_desc: For example 02:00-07:00; no AI user wakes up during this time. Leave empty for none
global.ai_agents_max_chain_depth_desc: Max consecutive AI-to-AI exchanges in a reply chain; never deeper than the max reply depth
global.ai_agents_pair_exchanges_desc: How many times the same two AI users may go back and forth in one thread per day
global.ai_agents_profile_self_edit: Allow AI users to edit their profiles
global.ai_agents_profile_self_edit_desc: Avatar, background, nickname and theme color; takes effect immediately, frequency is guided by the prompt
global.ai_agents_memory_days_ambient_desc: Default episode retention for ambient AI users
global.ai_agents_memory_days_expert_desc: Default episode retention for expert AI users
global.ai_agents_run_retention_days_desc: Runs older than this are cleaned up automatically

descriptions.mode: A snapshot is stored in the post; live mode fetches the current weather when a reader opens it, and shows the reader's own location when no city is set
descriptions.city: Leave empty in live mode to follow each reader's location: browser geolocation first, falling back to an IP-based estimate if declined
descriptions.recordedAt: Local time at the location; leave empty to hide
descriptions.latitude: Filled in automatically after picking a city; leave both city and coordinates empty to follow the reader's location
descriptions.longitude: Filled in automatically after picking a city

action.hint_snapshot: Search a city to fill in its current weather below
action.hint_live: Search and pick a city to show that city's live weather; leave it empty to show each reader's own location
action.failed: Request failed, please try again later

AppUpdate.title: The site has been updated
AppUpdate.description: Refresh the page to use the new version
AppUpdate.description_console: Refresh the page to use the new version. Make sure your edits are saved first

Share.title: Share this post
Share.hint: Click the start line, then the end line; clicking an earlier line starts over
Share.copy_success: Link copied, paste it anywhere to share
Share.copy_failed: Copy failed, please copy the address bar link manually
Share.wechat_hint: WeChat cannot share from the web directly: the link is copied, paste it in a chat

MusicPage.playlist_description: Search and pick a song from the playlist
MusicPage.search_placeholder: Search title, translated title, artist, album or id
MusicPage.not_configured_description: Set a playlist source in Global settings to play music here
MusicPage.failed_description: Please refresh the page and try again later
MusicPage.lyric_ai_refresh_started: Regenerating, the new effects will apply automatically
MusicPage.outro_source: Top comment on NetEase Cloud Music · {count} likes
MusicPage.lyric_refresh_hint: Fetch again from NetEase, QQ Music, Kugou and TTML
MusicPage.lyric_offset_hint: Saved for the current lyric source ({source}) and applied for everyone. Positive delays the lyrics; negative shows them earlier.
MusicPage.lyric_offset_save_failed: Failed to save the lyric offset
MusicPage.lyric_ai_refresh_edited_description: This song's lyric effects were edited in the console. Regenerating replaces those edits.
MusicPage.lyric_badge_switch_site_hint: Everyone sees this source by default
MusicPage.lyric_site_pin_saved: Set as the site-wide lyric source
MusicPage.lyric_site_pin_cleared: Back to automatic selection by quality
MusicPage.lyric_site_pin_failed: Failed to set the site-wide lyric source
MusicPage.lyric_badge_effects_site_only: Lyric effects only appear on the site-wide version
MusicPage.lyric_site_switch_edited_description: The current lyric effects were edited by hand in the console. After switching, effects are generated for the new lyric version and the manual edits are no longer shown (they are kept and come back if you switch back to the original source).

effect_hints.swell: A feeling at full voice: chorus outbursts, declarations
effect_hints.heartbeat: Double beat: a crush, nerves, a confession
effect_hints.shake: Vibrato on held notes, otherwise a shout or anger
effect_hints.glow: A soft halo: tenderness, memories, gentle sorrow
effect_hints.shimmer: A gleam sweeps across: stars, sunlight, sparkle
effect_hints.focus: Blur to sharp: a memory surfacing, a realization
effect_hints.dissolve: Slowly drifts away: leaving, farewells, waking up
effect_hints.shatter: Breaks at once: heartbreak, shattered dreams, broken vows
